mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FLIGHT_PURCHASE_SIMULATION ( purchase_no, user_idx, spot_idx, offer_id, provider_type, payment_idx, airline_name, flight_no, origin_airport_code, destination_airport_code, departure_time, arrival_time, trip_type, return_airline_name, return_flight_no, return_origin_airport_code, return_destination_airport_code, return_departure_time, return_arrival_time, outbound_price, return_price, total_price, used_cash, used_mileage, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{purchaseNo}, #{userIdx}, #{spotIdx}, #{offerId}, #{providerType}, #{paymentIdx}, #{airlineName}, #{flightNo}, #{originAirportCode}, #{destinationAirportCode}, #{departureTime}, #{arrivalTime}, #{tripType}, #{returnAirlineName}, #{returnFlightNo}, #{returnOriginAirportCode}, #{returnDestinationAirportCode}, #{returnDepartureTime}, #{returnArrivalTime}, #{outboundPrice}, #{returnPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{usedCash}, #{usedMileage}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT flight_purchase_idx, purchase_no, user_idx, spot_idx, offer_id, provider_type, payment_idx, airline_name, flight_no, origin_airport_code, destination_airport_code, departure_time, arrival_time, trip_type, return_airline_name, return_flight_no, return_origin_airport_code, return_destination_airport_code, return_departure_time, return_arrival_time, outbound_price, return_price, total_price, used_cash, used_mileage, status, cancel_reason, created_at FROM FLIGHT_PURCHASE_SIMULATION WHERE flight_purchase_idx = #{flightPurchaseIdx} AND user_idx = #{userIdx} FOR UPDATE
